cells.name: orders
cells.sql:
SELECT *
FROM (VALUES
  (101, 'Maya', 'paid', 120.00),
  (102, 'Jonah', 'pending', 85.50),
  (103, 'Maya', 'paid', 240.00),
  (104, 'Elena', 'paid', 64.00),
  (105, 'Jonah', 'refunded', 39.00)
) AS orders(id, customer, status, amount);

cells.name: by_customer
cells.sql:
SELECT customer,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       SUM(amount) AS total
FROM notebook.paid_orders
GROUP BY customer
ORDER BY total DESC;
